text:
alex: CI job 4821 failing on image push after my base-image bump PR landed. build passed but push -> registry denied.
priya: ugh, which registry? can you paste the push log?
alex: registry: registry.internal.redwood:5000/redwood/runtime
alex: log:
```
Pushing to registry.internal.redwood:5000/redwood/runtime:feature/base-slim
DENIED: requested access to the resource is denied.
failed to push some refs to 'registry.internal.redwood:5000/redwood/runtime'
``` 
ci-bot: Job 4821 failed: push-step (exit code 1) — logs uploaded: https://ci.internal/logs/4821
jonathan: did the release script rotate tokens yesterday? ops-bot did a creds refresh on hosts last night.
maria: looks like the tag got flipped by the nightly-release job — it's trying to push feature/base-slim to :latest namespace which we don't allow.
alex: hmm i only changed FROM python:3.11-slim -> python:3.12-slim in Dockerfile, no tag logic.
priya: can someone re-run the job with --no-cache? maybe cached layer references an older manifest
alex: trying a manual rerun now
ci-bot: Rerun requested by alex — job 4821.2 queued.
jonathan: also can someone bisect between commits abc1de4..f90b12a? if the release job updated tag logic that could explain it.
maria: bisect assigned to priya
priya: started bisect on main, will post findings. quick test: `docker build --no-cache -t registry.internal.redwood:5000/redwood/runtime:feature/base-slim . && docker push ...`
alex: rerun finished — still failing with same DENIED. 
priya: bisect found the change:  f90b12a — nightly-release: "only push tags to namespaces matching repo-perms", it incorrectly translated feature/* -> latest. open PR to fix.
alex: thanks priya. ops-bot, can you temporarily allow CI service account to push to repo so we can unblock deploys?
ops-bot: Granted push for ci-service-account to registry.internal.redwood:5000/redwood/runtime for 30m. Audit id: AUD-2026-03-17-987
alex: retriggering push once perms live
ci-bot: Job 4821.3 succeeded: image pushed as registry.internal.redwood:5000/redwood/runtime:feature/base-slim
alex: rollback/patch PR merged to nightly-release to stop tag remapping. will keep an eye on canaries :thumbsup:
maria: great, thanks all — leaving notes in the incident tracker.
